description: Went to Mr. Pumpernickel's gnome garden party
body: Mr. Pumpernickel threw a garden party for the lane's gnomes. Brought turnip crisps. Mrs. Grimsby brought six of her gnomes.

description: Dr. Jekyll raised moonberry tonic to 4 drops nightly; ear still glows faintly
body:
Follow-up at the Lantern Street Apothecary. The ear glows less but still shows in the dark.

## Potions
- Moonberry tonic: up from 2 to 4 drops nightly
- Thistle draught: unchanged, 1 spoon each morning
